name: number-pop-in
title: Number Pop In
description: A transitions.dev-inspired digit pop-in with blur, lift, and staggered value reveal

variables.label: Value
variables.description: The number itself. Every character becomes its own span, so the stagger still lands character by character.

variables.label: Unit
variables.description: Small suffix printed after the number. Pass an empty string to drop it.

variables.label: Lift
variables.description: Scales the offset the timeline drives, so the characters cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Number colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
